svg.text: IN: THE COPPER, ALL 97 LETTERS, THE 24 KNOWN PLACES IN ACCENT
one unknown alphabet, Beaufort form, key length 23 or 26: every move keeps the 24 known letters consistent; the whole text, known words included, is scored
best English score of all 97 letters (higher is more English); 1,000 restarts x 100,000 moves for every text, in compiled code
hidden English, best the climb found
the planted texts climb above the coppers at 23 (10 of 12) but none comes back: the climb notices English it cannot read; at 26 it notices 5 of 12
OUT: K4'S BEST AT LENGTH 23, NINTH OF 13 AMONG ITS COPPERS; OVERFITTED FRAGMENTS, NOT A READING
